title: Fix plan/apply staleness and op-id collisions (VC-201-063)
goal: ConfigStore::plan records no precondition for keys absent from values, so a plan inserting a new key still applies after a concurrent write set that key — a stale plan overwrites instead of failing safely (vc_201_063_mastery_stale_insertion_plan_overwrites_concurrent_write). Op IDs are op-<key>, so a second plan changing the same key reuses the applied ID and its mutation is skipped as a replay (vc_201_063_mastery_second_change_to_same_key_is_silently_skipped). Fix: record presence preconditions (absent => must-stay-absent) for every op, and derive op IDs from change content (key+from+to), not the key alone.
